findings.title: Keep React message resources in i18next format
findings.body: This replaces i18next's `{{0}}`, `{{1}}`, and `{{2}}` interpolation tokens with Java MessageFormat tokens and a Java choice expression. The React account console does not evaluate MessageFormat, so multivalued-size validation errors will display literal placeholders and choice syntax instead of the attribute name and limits. The same regression is introduced in the admin UI's `messages_en.properties` at line 3138. Keep these React resources in the format supported by i18next.

findings.title: Restore Lithuanian OTP setup instructions
findings.body: The new `totpStep1` value is Italian (`Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare`), although this is the Lithuanian resource bundle. The same Italian text is introduced as `loginTotpStep1` in the Lithuanian login bundle at line 71. Lithuanian users now receive OTP setup instructions in an unrelated language; replace both values with Lithuanian translations.
